project_identity.name: SIM MI Miftahul Jannah
project_identity.tagline: Sistem Informasi Manajemen Madrasah Ibtidaiyah Terpadu
project_identity.aesthetic_theme: Modern Islamic Clean Educational (Clean Madrasah Identity)
project_identity.primary_archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY / SWISS HYBRID WITH ISLAMIC ACCENTS
project_identity.description: A refined, professional full-online school management platform tailored for Indonesian Islamic Elementary Schools (Madrasah Ibtidaiyah). Features rich deep maroon identity accents paired with noble emerald green, warm antique gold, and soft ivory background surfaces for high legibility, warmth, and institutional authority.

rules.contrast_standard: APCA / WCAG AA (Minimum 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large display)
rules.gradient_policy: Strictly limited to hero branding containers and kiosk headers. Never overlay dark gradients across global UI.
rules.tinted_greys: Always tint neutral borders and card backgrounds with a warm 2% yellow/sand hue (#FAF8F5) to eliminate sterile digital blues.

arabic_script.usage: Quran Surah titles, Tahfidz verses, Basmalah banners, and Islamic motto labels

layout_and_navigation.file_type_note: Target frontend codebase uses JavaScript (.js) files.

elements: Madrasah Logo image placeholder / uploaded brand logo with clean shadow
School Name: 'MI MIFTANUL JANNAH' + NISM/NPSN metadata tag

testing_and_data_testid_conventions.rule: Every button, input, tab, card, link, select, and feedback notification MUST contain a descriptive kebab-case data-testid attribute.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Ensure zero text collision inside cards and tables by enforcing p-4 or p-6 padding.
Do not use dark gradient overlays on content surfaces. Use crisp solid white/ivory card backgrounds with 1px subtle amber/slate borders.
All modals, popovers, select dropdowns, and date pickers must have solid non-transparent background colors.
Use smooth micro-interactions (hover lift, active press states, focus rings) on all interactive elements.
Use Toast notifications (via sonner / toast hook) for immediate user feedback on all save, update, delete, and kiosk actions.
Maintain strict mobile responsiveness with sticky header, collapsible sidebar, and scrollable horizontal tables on smaller screens.
